text: Jordan spent the afternoon documenting the analytics dashboard for a successor they'll never meet, wryly noting the irony of polishing their best work at Meridian while facing an uncertain future there. At Groundwork, they finally cracked open a long-carried fix for the free-play review screen, stripping out the "trophy-case" framing (highlights, best-moments language) in favor of neutral marks that ask what a moment means rather than assuming it's good—a rewrite that felt more honest, even if it meant discarding most of the code. Emotionally, Jordan feels calmer than expected with the onsite and Priya conversation looming (nine and six days out), attributing the ease to the sense that the doors are still open, though they stay watchful of Pepper's odd vigilance by the window.
